meta.notes: The Americas are the M12d counterpart of the M12a European, M12b Asian and M12c African province systems. Provinces are permanent geographical units with stable ids; modern admin-1 units are only internal geometry blocks and the 1900 outer boundary is the authored M11c polity polygon. Americas ids start at 300001 and every key is prefixed am-, disjoint from Europe, Asia and Africa. Newfoundland is a 1900 registry polity so its 1949 union with Canada is an ordinary transfer.
